canonical_root_deploy.reason: No service deployment or restart is part of L12-DIST-001; root distillation wiring and hosted admission remain outside this slice.

identity_admission.proof: Only normalized SourceRecord versions are admitted to the ledger; a rejected record is refused and leaves no outbox row. Job identity is the content digest of the normalized version, and a contradicting payload under the same identity aborts the whole admission transaction.

publish_cut.reason: Hosted admission remains delegated to L12-HOSTED-001.

pre_deploy.environment: real services/registry FastAPI app served over real HTTP on a loopback port
pre_deploy.terminal_readback: A full controller tick drove a normalized SourceRecord through the real registry service. The registered entry was read back over HTTP at artifact_state draft, and metadata.distillation retained source_id, source_digest, and source_event_version across the round trip.

proof: Job identity is the SHA-256 content digest of the normalized source version, so admitting the same content twice returns one job and one committed version row.

Run-local correlation fields (ingest_run_id, source_ingest_run_id, trace_id) are excluded from the digest, so an identical re-crawl in a later run resolves to the committed version instead of creating a second job or failing admission.
Revised content produces a distinct digest, a distinct job, and a distinct versioned Registry draft; two revisions of one source yielded exactly two Registry entries.
Repeated controller ticks after terminal success perform no further Registry write and leave one job and one seed.
A Registry write failure raises DistillationControllerError at stage registry_sync; the controller records a failure tick and no success, and consecutive_failures increments.
The failed job is parked as retry_wait with a backoff next_attempt_at and the failure reason, rather than being acknowledged.
After the attempt budget is exhausted the job becomes dead_letter and a durable dead-letter row retains the committed payload, so it stays redrivable.
A real connection failure against a port with nothing listening produces the same truthful degraded outcome as the simulated outage.
A job is acknowledged only after a terminal Registry readback; the write response alone never completes the job.
The source snapshot is committed in the same transaction as the outbox event, so replay reads the exact version the event meant rather than a later in-memory revision.
metadata.distillation carries source_id, source_digest, source_event_version, and distillation_job_id into the Registry entry, preserving source-to-draft lineage.
The Registry sink receives the exact evidence item and bundle the seed was materialized from, keeping the registered artifact inside the StrategySpecSeed lineage.

A worker that claims a job and dies before reaching the Registry leaves an expired lease; the lease is recovered to pending and a later tick replays it to exactly one terminal draft with exactly one Registry write.
A Registry write that lands while its acknowledgement is lost is replayed by versioned readback: the second pass reaches done with no second Registry entry, one job, and one seed.
A completion presented with a stale lease token is rejected, so a resurrected worker cannot overwrite the outcome of the worker that superseded it.
Recovery is exercised through the real lease ledger and real spawned OS processes, and the replay outcome is asserted from the persisted ledger rather than from an in-test substitute.
Admission is a single BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction: a contradicting payload under an existing version identity rolls back, leaving the committed version and outbox unchanged.
Exhausted delivery compensates into a durable dead-letter table that retains the committed payload and supports operator redispatch, which clears the dead letter with redrive attribution.
Registry artifacts in approved or retired state are never mutated; the job is marked skipped instead.
This slice grants no broker, deployment, runtime-control, or live-capital mutation authority.

environment_boundary.proof: Only merged Pantheon dev integration, focused service acceptance, and a bounded loopback registry service were exercised. No external network egress, no hosted activation, and no real provider crawl are claimed.

mfa.proof: This internal worker lane changes no interactive operator authentication or MFA policy.

no_live_capital.proof: Distillation produces reviewable StrategySpec drafts only. It has no broker or capital authority and no live-capital path was enabled.

rbac.proof: No authorization surface is added or relaxed. Registry writes continue to go through the existing StrategySpec facade, and the approval gate is unchanged.

tenant_isolation.proof: The distillation ledger is keyed by source identity within a single service-owned store; this slice introduces no cross-tenant read or write path.

two_person_approval.proof: Owner Claude and reviewer Antigravity are distinct. The formal independent approval must be appended to record_log after review and before done.

acceptance.statement: A committed normalized SourceRecord transactionally enqueues exactly one versioned distillation job.
Concurrent workers claim under an exclusive lease, and duplicate or revised content is resolved by source digest.
Registry failure records controller failure plus a durable retry or dead letter, and is never recorded as success.
Approved immutable artifacts remain unchanged, including when approval lands between the probe and the terminal readback.
A crash before or after the Registry write replays to exactly one terminal draft.
The packet's four required proofs are met, including a real source-to-Registry service test over real HTTP and a genuine two-process concurrency test.

jsonl_seed_store_tier.containment: Read-modify-write mutations now hold a cross-process flock lease, proven by a negative control that loses seeds without it. The job ledger itself is already SQLite-transactional.
jsonl_seed_store_tier.description: The StrategySpecSeed draft store remains a dev-tier JSONL file rather than Postgres, so it relies on a filesystem lease rather than database transactions.
jsonl_seed_store_tier.expiry: When the seed store is migrated to the shared Postgres tier.
jsonl_seed_store_tier.recheck_trigger: Before running distillation workers across hosts that do not share a filesystem.

registry_sink_single_writer.containment: Registry identity is the versioned registry_id, so a concurrent duplicate write is resolved by readback into already_terminal rather than a second draft.
registry_sink_single_writer.description: Two workers processing two versions of the same source can call the Registry concurrently; ordering between versions is not serialized.
registry_sink_single_writer.expiry: When per-source ordering is required by a downstream consumer.
registry_sink_single_writer.recheck_trigger: If a consumer begins depending on strict per-source version ordering of Registry drafts.

hosted_activation.containment: The task-owned acceptance is fail closed and does not claim hosted behavior.
hosted_activation.description: Hosted deployment of the distillation controller remains a downstream responsibility.
